sections.h2: What Lakeside at the Park homes are like
paragraphs: Lakeside at the Park is a small, newer community near Briarcliff, with modern homes priced from about $600K to $1M. No gate and no HOA are listed for Lakeside at the Park. Homes here are recent builds, so expect clean lines, big windows, and light colored stucco or siding with metal accents. The location, near the shores of Lake Travis, gives many homes a feel of being near the water without the cost of a waterfront lot. Streets are still maturing, with young trees and landscaping that has not filled in yet.
Modern design means modern glass: large panes, black frames and sliding walls that open to the patio.

sections.h2: What Lakeside at the Park windows deal with
paragraphs: Recent builds mean fresh dust. Construction around the area leaves fine dirt on finished windows, and open land nearby keeps it coming. Hard water from irrigation leaves white mineral spots on lower panes, and being near the lake adds humidity and haze. With young landscaping, the sun hits the glass directly, so afternoon streaks stand out on west facing walls. Cedar pollen in winter and live oak pollen in spring coat the glass, and tracks collect the grit from sliding doors.
Black frames and large panes show water marks and fingerprints more than older glass does.
